sections.changelog:
2.6.0

  • Cannibalization consolidation from the GSC read: several of our own pages were fighting over one query and Google buried all of them. The weaker page canonical now points at the stronger one (through Yoast, reversible, not a redirect), concentrating the equity: the duplicate divorce-mediation page onto the main one, the duplicate divorce-agreement template onto the hero, the overlapping Portugal relocation guide onto the ranking one. Extensible map as more cannibalization is confirmed.

2.5.2

  • The internal-authority mesh now covers five practice clusters (family, criminal, real estate, labor, nezikin), reusing the sponsored-cards family map so it matches the same articles. Each cluster feeds its buried money pages: criminal record certificates and Lahav 433, the real-estate price forecast and apartment guide, the severance calculators, the medical-malpractice guide, each with its pillar and the AI desk.

2.5.1

  • Accessibility from the live audit: the intake wizard form labels are now programmatically associated (for/id + autocomplete) so screen readers and browser autofill work, and the cinematic map div carries a role so its label is announced, pointing screen-reader users to the accessible area and city finder above it.

2.5.0

  • Content hierarchy and internal authority, from the GSC read: the money pages were buried on page 3-6 with almost no internal links (the recommended-family-lawyers page sat at position 64 as a literal orphan). A curated related-pages mesh now feeds authority from each practice pillar and its articles into the money pages in the same family, and the four tool pages (legal-help, calculators, documents, ask-a-lawyer) get the meta descriptions the theme and Yoast left blank.

2.4.1

  • The AI Legal Desk now leads the get-help page (above the older step wizard), the money-page finder points to it, and the hourly monitor watches it render.

2.4.0

  • The AI Legal Desk: the one-action front door. Describe what happened or upload a document (a phone photo of a contract, a ticket, a letter) and get an instant plain-Hebrew read: what it is, the points that matter, your rights, the next steps, and a one-tap connection to a matching lawyer. Built on the graded brain with vision, framed as general guidance that always ends at a human (never a lawyer substitute), the upload is analyzed in memory and never stored, the endpoint is bot-guarded and rate limited, and the handoff routes through the existing lead engine carrying the situation summary and the asker hiring intent. New flagship page at legal-ai-desk, embedded across the help, calculators and documents surfaces. Closes the biggest competitor gap (din.co.il has no AI intake and no document upload) and answers the owner order to make the process one click.

2.3.1

  • With the national court set on the map, the drone's closing overview now rests on the paying lawyers rather than fitting the whole country (Eilat to the north) into frame; the courts stay on the map as labeled chips within the view.

2.3.0

  • The national court layer: every court and the main government complexes are now labeled on the map. The Supreme Court, all six district courts, every magistrate branch, the labor courts and the government complexes are seeded from the Judicial Authority directory: each carries its official published street address and its coordinates come from geocoding that address on the server, never from a hand-typed latitude. A proximity guard keeps the shared Hall of Justice buildings (district and magistrate under one roof) from double-pinning. Courts render as gold scales-of-justice chips, government as classical-building chips, each with a one-tap navigate link. Idempotent admin seed at seed-courts.

2.2.2

  • Map hardening from live QA: the WhatsApp prefill decodes entity-escaped titles before URL encoding (a stored gershayim arrived as a literal quot entity inside the message), the premium enrichment lives only in the always-on filter (the copy inside the self-retiring theme bridge is gone), and the journey monitor now watches the map: the money article must carry the embed and the offices feed must serve a premium office with a portrait.

2.2.1

  • Map fixes from live QA: the premium enrichment moved out of the self-retired theme bridge into an always-on filter, and the token resolves through the theme resolver first (after the theme pull the token lives in theme storage and the empty plugin option silenced every surface).

2.2.0

  • Cinematic map: Mapbox Standard 3D with native Hebrew POI labels (courts and government buildings labeled by the basemap), drone intro onto the top paying office with a slow orbit and overview, aerial tour button across all premium offices, gold flag markers with portraits for paying lawyers, quiet logo chips for everyone else, IP-approximate start region without any permission prompt, reduced-motion respected, lazy load near viewport so page speed never pays. Lawyer finder strip (area and city, server-rendered links) above the map, embedded AFTER content on money surfaces. Offices GeoJSON enriched with premium flag, profile url, portrait and WhatsApp.

2.1.1

  • SLA ages parse the routed stamp in the site timezone: strtotime read it as UTC and would have delayed every escalation by the site offset.

2.1.0

  • Marketplace science layer: SLA escalation engine on a 15 minute cron (tier one reminder at 30 minutes, tier two reassignment to the next performance-ranked lawyer at 90, full evidence trail per lead), performance-weighted matching inside equal paid tiers (median response and acknowledge rate earn a bonus, recent escalations cost one; paid tier always dominates), truthful social proof strip on the intake and Q&A surfaces that hides any figure under the floor, post-submit expectation panel, market stats on the cockpit and a market-stats endpoint.

2.0.1

  • Article machine outputs pass the brain rubric judge before shipping (failing drafts re-enter the retry path). Brain quality counters on the cockpit. Reader UX: automatic anchored table of contents on long-form content (collapsible on mobile, open on desktop) and a reading progress bar.

2.0.0

  • The AI brain: every machine output can now run a research-backed pipeline: retrieval grounding in our own published pages with woven internal links, Chain-of-Verification fact pass (arXiv 2309.11495), MT-Bench style rubric judge (arXiv 2306.05685) gating on accuracy framing, iron rules, clarity and helpfulness, one Self-Refine attempt on judge feedback (arXiv 2303.17651), self-consistency title selection with three candidates and a judge pick (arXiv 2203.11171), deterministic scrub last, full per-output trace and daily counters. Q&A drafts and SERP titles ride the brain; brain-status and brain-test endpoints.

1.9.6

  • Question singles get the same routing bridge the encyclopedia needed: the theme request guard force-retypes named requests and 404ed /q/ pages.

1.9.5

  • Q&A hardening from live QA: slugs forced past a companion filter that strips post_name on pending inserts, leads route directly in the publish transition instead of relying on the meta hook, draft failures record their reason.

1.9.4

  • Ask-a-lawyer Q&A engine: guarded public question form, machine-drafted general answers under the iron rules held pending for one-click owner approval, QAPage JSON-LD, questions join the practice-areas taxonomy so the sponsored cards mesh picks them up, and askers who leave a phone become routable leads on publish. The cards mesh singular-type list is now filterable.

1.9.3

  • Schema hooks trust the queried object instead of is_page: the theme routing guard force-retypes page queries and silenced the FAQPage and Attorney JSON-LD.

1.9.2

  • AI answer surfaces: /llms.txt generated from the live registries (hubs, calculators, generators, encyclopedia, directory), FAQPage JSON-LD on calculator and generator pages, Attorney JSON-LD with gated aggregateRating on city practice pages.

1.9.1

  • Document generators (demand letter, parking ticket appeal): hand-written neutral skeletons assembled in the browser, copy or send-to-lawyer-review WhatsApp paths, index page, FAQ blocks. Response-time badge on cards computed from real routing telemetry (median acknowledge time, 3+ samples, 12h cache). Routed lead mails include a short model-suggested first reply. Monitor covers the calculators and intake pages.

1.9.0

  • Legal calculators suite (severance, recuperation pay, annual leave, small claims fee): stable statutory formulas only, updatable dated rates in options, FAQ blocks, WhatsApp CTA carrying the computed result, auto-created English-slug pages plus a calculators index. Intake brain at /legal-help/: three-step deterministic triage (area, situation, urgency) ending in a context-carrying WhatsApp handoff and a prefilled lead form that routes and bills through the existing engine.

1.8.7

  • City by practice landing engine, inventory-gated: pages generate only where eligible advertisers carry the city term, with a machine opening under the iron rules, advertiser cards, family guides and hub link; weekly auto-generation as new advertisers join. Owner cockpit: monitor state, 7 day card performance, advertiser roster with renewals, machine counters and SERP experiment tallies on one wp-admin screen plus cockpit-json. GSC property fixed to the URL-prefix the service account is permissioned on.

1.8.6

  • SERP title machine: weekly Search Console strike-zone scan (positions 4-15, real impressions), iron-rule titles applied to both title channels with full experiment records, three week measurement with automatic revert of losers, owner mail per change, serp-status and serp-run endpoints, weekly cron, pause option.

1.8.5

  • Reviews move to the justice_review CPT with self-computed lawyer aggregates: the historical justice_recommendation type name exceeds the WordPress 20 character post type limit and the wp_posts column width, so it can never register and its inserts fail; the star gate reads the recomputed meta directly.

1.8.4

  • Recommendation CPT registered by the plugin until the theme carries it (the live companion never registered it and an insert-hardening filter rejected review inserts); lead acknowledge and confirmation pages render direct HTML instead of a JSON-encoded string.

1.8.3

  • Verified reviews engine: review links are minted only from real CRM leads (tokenized, one per lead), reviews land pending with an owner moderation mail, approval writes a native recommendation so the theme aggregates and the gated stars unlock organically; a review without a real lead is structurally impossible. Lead acknowledge became a confirm-button POST: mail scanners prefetch GET links and were false-acknowledging leads.

1.8.2

  • Lead router: new public leads map their legal area to a practice family and route to the top eligible advertiser (cards eligibility engine, monthly_lead_limit honored), with routed price stamped as billing evidence, lawyer mail with a one-tap acknowledge link, owner mail with a prefilled WhatsApp forward, and a leads-summary endpoint.

1.8.1

  • Self-serve advertiser funnel: /advertise/ plan tiers and application form (honeypot and bot-floor guarded), applications become draft profiles with an owner mail and prefilled WhatsApp reply, one-click activation publishes the profile and sets the plan score with a 30 day renewal cycle, wp-admin Justice Advertise screen (queue plus active roster), daily lapse watchdog zeroes expired scores and mails the owner. Manual payment mode until a processor is chosen.

1.8.0

  • Synthetic journey monitor: hourly walk of the money paths (home, family hub with body and lead nonce, money article with card, flagship profile portrait, abroad pillar, encyclopedia, news sitemap, healthcheck), transition-only alert mail, 48-run ring log, monitor-status and monitor-run endpoints.
  • Card analytics: viewable-impression and click beacons per lawyer per surface per day into a compact aggregate table, per-IP caps, card-stats endpoint, monthly per-advertiser proof report mail.

1.7.6

  • Lead timing guard: pages cached longer than a day carried a stale started_at stamp and every lead from them was rejected as timing spam; the corrected guard keeps the 3 second bot floor and drops the stale upper bound.

1.7.5

  • The content bridge resolves the landing page by URL path: controlled practice routes force-retype the main query, so is_page and the global post cannot be trusted there.

1.7.4

  • The practice-landing content bridge opens its buffer before the theme controlled routes that render and exit at template_redirect -999999.

1.7.3

  • Practice landing bridge: pages routed through the practice-landing template render their own post_content inside the pillar body (the live theme predates the repo content slot); self-retires when the theme output carries the slot natively.

1.7.2

  • /contact-us/ redirect moved to init with a raw path match: the theme routing guard rewrites 404 state before template_redirect.

1.7.1

  • Lawyer mini-site polish: the profile hero shows the dedicated portrait instead of the wide banner when card_photo_id exists; social share image for profiles is the portrait instead of the site logo; the floating WhatsApp bar on profiles names the lawyer in the prefill; /contact-us/ 301s to the live /contact/ page.

1.7.0

  • Professional cards redesigned to marketplace grade: gradient-border card with layered elevation, navy ribbon with gold flag label, conic gradient avatar ring with the geometry locked inline (aspect-ratio + object-fit survive any theme CSS), square-crop avatar source with retina srcset and a card_photo_id override meta, practice-area and city chips, verified license and experience trust row, 48px CTA pair with hierarchy, reduced-motion support. Second card requires a second lawyer and a minimum gap. Settings page: Settings > Justice Cards (enable, max, gap, colors, labels). Deploy hygiene: aggregates no longer wiped on upgrade.

1.6.2

  • Card styles print from wp_head: style tags inside post content are stripped by sanitization, so the cards rendered bare.

1.6.1

  • Cards resolve the page family from its own practice-areas terms first; candidates pass the theme public-approval gate; only profiles with a positive priority score float, keeping the score as the placement dial.

1.6.0

  • Professional cards: sponsored lawyer cards rendered inside articles, posts and encyclopedia entries by practice family, ranked by priority score with daily rotation among equals, rich mobile-first card with photo, areas, city, verified license badge, WhatsApp CTA carrying page and lawyer context, and profile link; admin options for enable and per-page cap.

1.5.1

  • WhatsApp prefill separators survive URL escaping.

1.5.0

  • Practice-area polish: hero description trimmed to intro with the full guide moved to a readable full-width section (no content loss), taxonomy archives capped at 24 cards per page; sitewide floating WhatsApp lead button carrying page title and URL in the prefilled message, big labeled bar on mobile.

1.4.2

1.4.1

1.4.0

1.3.6

1.3.5

1.3.4

1.3.3

1.3.2
